results.title: Antonio Merino | Ph.D. Candidate in Economics
results.content: ## Antonio Merino. ## About Me. I am a Visiting Assistant Teaching Professor in the **Department of Economics at Florida International University**. **I am currently on the 2025–2026 academic job market.**. I am an applied microeconomist. My research focuses on development economics with a particular interest in policy evaluation, education and inequality. My job market paper examines the effect of losing a cash transfer on educational and labor outcomes, as well as its impact on the division of labor in Ecuador. I am also studying the effect of receiving unconditional cash transfers on migration and family formation and the effect of elderly pensions on human capital. I have taught *Principles of Microeconomics, Principles of Macroeconomics, Intermediate Microeconomics, Measurement and Analysis of Economic Activity, and Urban Economics*.
